Normal.audio_text: You seem to be doing okay. Keep taking care of yourself and stay mindful.

Depression.audio_text: I am here with you. You are not alone. Take things one step at a time.

Suicidal.audio_text: I am really glad you reached out. Please consider talking to someone you trust or a professional right now.
tips: Reach out to a loved one immediately

Anxiety.audio_text: Take a slow breath. This feeling will pass. You are safe right now.

Bipolar.audio_text: Mood changes can be challenging. Support and structure can help you through this.

Stress.audio_text: You seem under pressure. Let us slow down and focus on what you can control.

Personality disorder.audio_text: Feeling disconnected can be painful. Awareness is the first step toward balance.
